trigger: 所有主控必需的冻结/标签/行身份/接口输入前提有效
actions: 按已选预算派发A；B1可与linear-only接口准备并行，B2在B1比较控制齐备后收齐；不要求A全12任务改善才允许B。
stop: 任何前提失败仅停依赖任务，报告operational failure，不污染质量比较
budget_ceiling: chosen tier 25/89/197 unique fits; no automatic increase
new_review: completed chosen registered stage or decisive failure

trigger: 某候选对同task两个共同seed均改善；幅度与历史seed范围同报，非统计显著性
actions: 保留候选及原控制；先完成预登记B/结构压力测试（若获预算），不要立刻对22任务推广或追加密集搜索。
stop: 结构压力测试反转则限定适用域，不转而选最有利split
new_review: mechanism/structural-split contrast contradicts current preferred explanation

trigger: F001两seed均不胜H0且不改善F010退化，或变换与已验分母完全等价
actions: 不扫更多floor；B1/B2或C用于判别头/优化解释；已获益10任务保持，不把无改善当任务无解。
stop: 若B/C也无可复现改进，停止当前scaler/MLP网格，才考虑已准入新表示。
budget_ceiling: 89 medium or197 large; reserves need new controller registration

trigger: 共同seed差值符号继续翻转，或一个种子的极端值主导均分
actions: 按不稳定记录；先已有盲预测分歧+固定0.5 seed平均候选。仅在控制器授权且新seed白名单已扩展时追加seed48/49，候选与同seed控制各一个。
stop: 不按Valid最好seed淘汰其他seed，不无限追加直至显著
budget_ceiling: conditional <=4 tasks ×2 configs ×2 newseeds=16 new fits; task selection rule: largest absolute delta sign reversal among currently unresolved tasks, ties lexicographic; expanded exact matrix must be registered before execution; outside197
new_review: extra-seed sign still unstable or beyond predeclared candidate cap

trigger: 新底座的version/license/full-row coverage/freeze interface通过，且大预算被批准
actions: 只运行N面板明确6task×2seed，不顺手扩全22或更大checkpoint。新资产成本首个真实科学批次测量，不另造model-quality pilot。
stop: 长SMILES/解析/构象覆盖不能保证则停该资产或task，不删行、截断冒充完整输入
budget_ceiling: 12fits per MiniMol/MoLFormer/Morgan main branch; fixed encoding groups
new_review: new representation yields different error/disagreement structure or asset requires changed scientific preprocessing

trigger: 嵌套outer无同类覆盖或过少可估组
actions: 报告不可估/跳过该split；不重新随机直到获得有利结果。原始rawgroup results保留但不称结构泛化。
stop: 没有有效结构比较不追加任意split
budget_ceiling: 24 maximum stress fits; skipped fits not repurposed automatically
new_review: group topology makes proposed stress design scientifically uninformative
